{{Top|leg}}
'''Cybernetic cavities''' were used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to discreetly conceal valuable cargo within their bodies or [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. Unlike traditional methods such as strapping goods to the body or swallowing them, the cavity allowed for small containers to be surgically implanted. While a full body scan or [[Holoscanner|holoscan]] could detect it, the cavity was nearly invisible during casual inspections and often went undetected by standard scanners.<ref name="Fly Casual">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The cybernetic cavity was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
